sentences.en: For the first time a satellite was launched into orbit.
sentences.zh: 首次将一颗卫星送入轨道。

sentences.en: A satellite was launched into orbit to monitor melting glaciers.
sentences.zh: 发射了一颗监测冰川融化的卫星。

sentences.en: Better to extend an olive branch than launch a missile.
sentences.zh: 最好伸出橄榄枝而不是发射导弹。

senses.zh: 发射（导弹、火箭等）；发起，发动；使…下水 -
发射；下水；汽艇；发行，投放市场
